standing.unreachable: Can’t reach the server right now. The phone works without it.

phone.incomplete: Give your Monitor ID and password.
phone.refused: That Monitor ID and password weren’t taken. Check them and try again.
phone.ended: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again: nothing on this phone is lost.
phone.offlineRefused: The server didn’t take your sign-in made without signal. Sign in again now there’s signal: nothing on this phone is lost.

inactive.other: Signed out after {count} minutes with nothing done. Sign in again: nothing on this phone is lost.

phone.noList: Signing in with no signal needs this phone’s login list, which it reads when somebody signs in on it with signal. Find signal and try again.

phone.anotherMonitorUnnamed: This phone holds another monitor’s work. With no signal, your supervisor hands it over with the master passcode.

phone.setUpFor: This phone is set up for {name} on {project}. {name} signs in now with their Monitor ID and password.
phone.passcodeSession: Open a session with the master passcode
phone.phoneLocked: This phone is locked: the master passcode was typed wrong too many times with no signal. It opens when the master passcode is entered with signal.
phone.phoneLockedNoSignal: Can’t reach the server. This phone opens only when the master passcode is entered with signal: find signal and try again.
phone.handedTo: This phone is handed over to {name}. {name} signs in now with their Monitor ID and password.
phone.temporaryEnded: The temporary session under the master passcode has ended with the day. Sign in with your own Monitor ID and password: nothing on this phone is lost.

createMonitor.needs: Creating a monitor needs a connection and the master passcode.
createMonitor.name: Monitor’s name
createMonitor.phoneHint: Only if the firm keeps one.
createMonitor.incomplete: Give the monitor’s name, a password and the master passcode.

monitorCreated.title: Monitor created
monitorCreated.username: It is their username: they sign in with it and their password.

setup.offline: No signal: setting up on {project}, whose lists this phone holds.

project.title: Which project?
project.closed: That project has closed. Pick another.

work.title: What work?
work.hint: Pick each kind of work they do today.
work.none: Pick at least one kind of work.

site.title: Which site?
site.noneDetail: Collections and unit rate work at the curb

payItems.title: Which unit rate work?
payItems.nothing: This project has no unit rate work a monitor picks.

made.title: Phone set up
made.for: Set up for {name} on {project}, as an unplanned assignment.
made.held: Kept on the phone. It goes to the server when the phone finds signal with somebody signed in.
made.notSaved: The server didn’t take it. It stays on the phone, and the back office is told.

photos.full: That’s the most photos a ticket takes.

work.held: This phone holds the lists for {project}.

warning.other: You’ll be signed out in {count} seconds with nothing done.

sync.title: Sync

site.title: Which site now?

session.noCheck: This phone holds no check of the master passcode yet. Find signal and try again.
session.offline: No signal: the monitors on this phone’s login list.

monitor.title: Who is signing in?
